name: noticed-slowdown

finding.title: `seen` is now a list, so each duplicate check scans every email seen so far
finding.description: `email in seen` on a list compares against every earlier email, so an import of N rows does about N²/2 string comparisons. At the 50,000 rows `MAX_IMPORT_ROWS` allows, that is over a billion comparisons: an upload that took well under a second with the set now takes minutes while the user waits on the import page.
finding.suggestedFix: Keep the set for the membership check and append to the list only for the report order, or use a `dict` as an ordered set.

prDiff:

-    seen: set[str] = set()

     report = ImportReport()

         email = row["email"].strip().lower()
+        if email in seen:
